title: Ali G: Who Iz I? Trailer Previews Return of Classic Sacha Baron Cohen Character
content:
Sacha Baron Cohen is back as Ali G in Ali G: Who Iz I?. The first trailer previews the upcoming comedy film, which also marks Cohen’s directorial debut. Amazon MGM Studios will release the film in theaters on October 23, 2026. The project has been filmed in secret, keeping much of its story under wraps. […]
